introHeroTitle: Explore Canada's ocean data, all on one map
introHeroText: Search every CIOOS dataset published through ERDDAP™ servers and OBIS in one place. See where and when data was collected, narrow it down to exactly what you need, then download it or follow the direct link to the source.
introShowcase_wms_body: Open a gridded dataset drawn live from its ERDDAP™ server.
introShowcase_trajectory_body: Open a glider mission off Vancouver Island, its track drawn on the map.
introShowcase_stations_body: Zoom into the Gulf of St. Lawrence, where cells become profile and time-series markers.
introShowcase_coverage_body: Chart the whole catalogue over time, split by source or platform.
introShowcase_download_body: See the order window: sizes, filters and direct links.
introShowcase_nonna_body: Zoom into Halifax Harbour to see CHS NONNA soundings.
introFeature_explore_body: Colours show how many days of data exist in each place; zoom in and the cells break into individual stations, tracks and grids. Click anywhere to see what's there.
introFeature_search_body: Find datasets by title, or filter by ocean variable, platform, organization, time, depth or species, and draw an area on the map. The map and the list update as you go.
introFeature_download_title: Download it, or take the link
introFeature_download_body: Pick the datasets you want and have them prepared with your filters applied and sent to you by email. You can also copy the direct ERDDAP™ and OBIS links one at a time, all at once, or as a script.
tipInfoFeedback: Click the chat button to send us feedback! It helps improve this interface and find bugs.
introReopenText: Reopen this window any time with the ⓘ button beside the Data Explorer title.
tipsToggleLabel: Show tips on the map as I use the Explorer
tip_shareLink: The page address saves your view, filters, area and open dataset. Copy it to share, or bookmark it.
tip_whatsHere: On the What's here card, <download/> adds a dataset to your download. Click a row to open it.
tip_reshapeArea: Drag the corners or points of a drawn area to reshape it. Clear it from the Area button.
tip_inView: The eye button under Filters keeps only datasets in the map view.
tip_sliderKeys: Click the time bar to move the nearest handle. The arrow keys step 1 day, Shift + arrow 30 days, Page Up / Down 1 year.
tip_timeCoverage: Not sure which dates to pick? Time coverage in the top bar charts the data over time.
tip_datasetNav: Double-click a dataset's title to zoom to it. Backspace or swipe left to go back.
tip_realtime: Real-time: still producing data at the last harvest. Filter for these under Filters → When & Where.
tip_trackDate: Each card is one trajectory. "Show on map" draws its full track; press again to clear it.
tip_griddapWms: Turn on Show on map to draw a gridded dataset, then pick a variable and step through time and depth.
tip_griddedCoverage: Gridded coverage, at the bottom of the legend, outlines every matching gridded dataset.
tip_nonna: Zoomed in this far, the seafloor shows CHS NONNA soundings. The Seafloor depth switch hides them.
tip_globe: Seeing the whole world? The globe button beside the title removes the stretched poles.
tip_sizeLimit: Downloads are limited to 1 GB per dataset. Narrow the time, depth or area, or use the direct ERDDAP™ links.
downloadModalSubtitleText: Review your selection, then receive it as a prepared archive by email or download it directly from the source.
feedbackButtonTitle: Please provide feedback on your experience using CIOOS Data Explorer
feedbackMessagePlaceholder: What went well? What could be better? Did something not work as expected?
topBarCountsInViewOffTitle: Stop showing only the datasets within the current map view
spatialFilterMenuTitle: Select an area on the map
drawHint_reshape: Drag any corner to reshape it.
drawHint_boxStart: Click one corner of the box.
drawHint_boxStart_touch: Tap one corner of the box.
drawHint_boxEnd: Click the opposite corner to finish. Esc cancels.
drawHint_boxEnd_touch: Tap the opposite corner to finish.
drawHint_polygonStart: Click to place the polygon's first point.
drawHint_polygonStart_touch: Tap to place the polygon's first point.
drawHint_polygonNext: Click to add the next point. Esc cancels.
drawHint_polygonNext_touch: Tap to add the next point.
drawHint_polygonFinish: Click to add a point. Double-click, click the first point or press Enter to finish.
drawHint_polygonFinish_touch: Tap to add a point. Double-tap or tap the first point to finish.
quickFilterAreaTitle: Filter by an area drawn on the map
oceanVariableFilterTooltip: Filter data by ocean variable name. Selection works as logical OR operation; switch on "Match all selected variables" to keep only data measuring every one of them.
platformFilterTooltip: Filter data by platform type. Click an option once to include it, again to exclude it, a third time to clear it. Included options work as logical OR; excluded ones are removed from the result.
organizationFilterTooltip: Filter data by responsible organisation name. Click an option once to include it, again to exclude it, a third time to clear it. Included options work as logical OR; excluded ones are removed from the result.
datasetFilterTooltip: Filter data by dataset name. Click an option once to include it, again to exclude it, a third time to clear it. Included options work as logical OR; excluded ones are removed from the result.
sourceFilterTooltip: Filter data by data portal: ERDDAP servers and OBIS nodes. Clicking OBIS includes or excludes all OBIS nodes; expand it to pick individual nodes. Click an option once to include it, again to exclude it, a third time to clear it. Included options work as logical OR; excluded ones are removed from the result.
sourceFilterObisGroupTooltip: Select all OBIS nodes, or expand to pick individual nodes
timeframeFilterTooltip: Filter data by timeframe. Selection works as inclusive range.
depthrangeFilterTooltip: Filter data by depth. Selection works as inclusive range.
scientificNameFilterTooltip: Filter OBIS data by scientific or common name. Common-name matches (e.g. "killer whale") resolve to the underlying scientific name via the World Register of Marine Species. Selection works as logical OR. Downloaded records still contain all species in the matching datasets.
scientificNameFilterSearchPlaceholder: Search by scientific or common name...
scientificNameFilterDisabledTooltip: Include OBIS in the Data Portal filter to filter by scientific name
scientificNameFilterNoResults: No matching scientific or common names
dateFilterInvalidWarning: Time filter not applied, invalid values.
datasetsTableHeaderLocationsTitle: Sort by number of selected locations in dataset
datasetsTableHeaderSizeTitle: Sort by approximate dataset size in megabytes
datasetsCardOnlyInViewTitle: Show only datasets within the current map view
datasetsCardInViewCountText: {{count}} datasets in the current map view
datasetsCardGroupHideFromMapTitle: Hide this group from the map
datasetsCardGroupShowOnMapTitle: Show this group on the map
datasetsTableLocationsTitle: Ratio of selected locations from dataset
datasetInspectorDownloadTitle: Add this dataset to the selection and open the download
datasetInspectorDownloadInSelectionTitle: Remove this dataset from the download selection
datasetInspectorClickPreviewText: Click a feature to preview its data, or "Show on map" to point it out on the map.
datasetInspectorMapClickHint: The highlighted feature was found under your last click on the map
coverageButtonTitle: Show how the data is distributed over time, split by source, platform, data type or organization
coverageModalSubtitleText: Number of datasets over time, using the applied filters (adjust the depth filter to focus a layer)
coverageDaysNote: Each timeseries, trajectory, point and grid contributes its own days, and these are added together. A period can therefore total more days than it contains.
coverageOrganizationNote: A dataset can belong to several organizations, so it is counted under each one. The stacked bars can therefore total more than the number of datasets.
coverageEmptyMessage: No datasets match the applied filters.
coverageErrorMessage: The figure could not be loaded. Please try again.
legendNoDataWarningTitle: Choose less restrictive filters to see data
downloadDetailsDownloadDataSteps2: Ensure selections are within the 100MB limit,
downloadDetailsDownloadDataSteps3: Provide an email address to receive the download link, and,
downloadDetailsDownloadDataSteps4: Submit the download request. Filters applied in the CIOOS Data Explorer also apply to dataset downloads.
legendMetricDaysTitle: Hexagon colour and marker size both show how many days of data are covered here
legendTopTickClamped: The darkest colour covers everything above this, up to {{max}}
legendScaledToView: The colours are scaled to the hexagons seen at this zoom level, so the same colour means different amounts at different zooms
legendMarkerDaysPinned: Marker size shows days of data, the same count the hexagon colours show.
legendBathymetryTitle: Seafloor depth from CHS NONNA bathymetry. The Canadian Hydrographic Service publishes these tiles as pre-rendered colour rather than depth values, so the scale is calibrated from the imagery. Read it as approximate bands, not exact contours.
filterInfoButtonTitle: Learn more about the filter here
datasetPreviewPlotNoVariablesSelected: Pick at least one variable to plot.
datasetPreviewPlotBlockedNoColumns: This record came back with no columns, so there is nothing to plot.
datasetPreviewPlotBlockedType: CDE has no plot layout for {{type}} datasets. Use the table.
datasetPreviewPlotBlockedNoType: This dataset declares no data type, so CDE cannot tell how to lay a plot out. Use the table.
datasetPreviewPlotBlockedNoAxis: This {{type}} record has no column CDE can draw the other variables against: it looked for {{wanted}}.
datasetPreviewPlotBlockedNoMeasurements: This record has nothing numeric to draw: every column is an identifier, a quality flag, or text.
datasetPreviewPlotWantedTrack: a longitude, latitude or time column
datasetPreviewNoData: This dataset can not be previewed. Try again later
previewProfileSliceSampled: Profile {{index}} of {{shown}} reachable, sampled evenly from the {{total}} in this record
previewProfileSliceWindow: Every profile in the most recent rows of this record, drawn at once
datasetPreviewErrorNoData: This record has no data in the preview window. The dataset may have been updated since it was indexed.
datasetPreviewErrorUnavailable: The data server for this dataset did not respond. Try again in a few minutes.
datasetPreviewErrorNoRecordId: This dataset does not identify individual records, so a single one cannot be previewed. Use Download for the whole dataset.
datasetPreviewErrorNotFound: This record is no longer in the dataset.
datasetPreviewErrorNetwork: CDE could not reach its own server. Check your connection and try again.
resetFiltersButtonTooltipText: Clear all filters and polygon selection to defaults
downloadDetailsFilterQuestionTooltipText: Use Time, Depth and Space filters to change dataset download sizes. Active filters are applied to all datasets in a download. Use the available ERDDAP™ links to download large datasets.
downloadDetailsNoFiltersActiveMessage: No Time, Depth, or Space filters currently active
datasetTableDownloadModalCDEDownloadable: Requests for less than 1GB of data from a dataset can be downloaded through CDE
datasetTableDownloadModalNotCDEDownloada: Requests for more than 1GB of data from a dataset can be downloaded through the provided ERDDAP™ link
harvest.title: Harvest Status
harvest.overview.subtitle: {{count}} source in the harvest audit log.
harvest.overview.subtitle_plural: {{count}} sources in the harvest audit log.
harvest.run.title: Harvest Run
harvest.mode.incremental.label: file
harvest.mode.incremental.tip: File-based dataset: the harvester hashes its file list and skips re-querying ERDDAP when nothing has changed.
harvest.mode.full.label: source
harvest.mode.full.tip: Database-backed dataset: there is no file list to hash, so ERDDAP is re-queried on every harvest.
harvest.mode.unknown.tip: File detection unavailable: the harvester could not determine whether this dataset is file-based, so ERDDAP is re-queried.
harvest.realtime.label: Real-time
harvest.realtime.tip: This dataset was still producing data as of its last harvest. This is the same signal as the map's Real-time badge.
harvest.warning.label: Warning
layerProfileHint: One place, measured down through the water column: CTD casts, bottle samples
layerTimeseriesHint: One fixed place, measured over time: moorings, buoys, shore stations
layerTimeseriesProfileHint: One fixed place, measured through depth again and again: moored profilers, ADCPs
layerTrajectoriesHint: A moving path, measured along the way: ships underway, drifters, surface vehicles
layerTrajectoryProfileHint: A moving path, measured through depth as it goes: gliders, Argo floats, towed CTDs
layerObisHint: Where a species was recorded: OBIS surveys, net tows, visual counts
layerGridHint: A continuous field over an area, not individual stations: model output, satellite and reanalysis grids (griddap)
dataLayersFilterTooltip: Choose which observation geometries the map draws. Hidden ones are also left out of the datasets list and its counts.
timeBarResetRangeTitle: Clear the time range to all dates
gridTimeCountTitle: Time slice {{index}} of {{total}} in this dataset
depthBarResetRangeTitle: Clear the depth range to all depths
trajectoryTrailBandTitle: Track history drawn behind the trajectory date
trajectoryClickPreviewText: Click a trajectory to preview its data, or "Show on map" to draw its track.
datasetInspectorShowOnMapTitle: Point this feature out on the map
datasetInspectorHideFromMapTitle: Clear this feature from the map
trajectoryTrackShowTitle: Draw this trajectory's whole track on the map
legendTrackTrailZoomGated: Zoomed out, tracks load at most one year. Zoom in to load the full window.
legendTrackHead: Position and direction at selected date
datasetCardFromMapTitle: Found under your last click on the map
datasetsCardMapClickHint: Outlined datasets were found under your last click on the map
featureCardMapClickHint: Outlined the same way on the map and in the datasets list
featureCardEmpty: Nothing here is in the current results because the filters have excluded it.
featureCardAddOne: Add this dataset to the selection
griddapNotDownloadableTooltip: Gridded datasets are accessed directly on ERDDAP
zoomToDatasetTitle: Zoom the map to this dataset's extent
griddapNoWmsText: Map preview is not available for this dataset. Access it on ERDDAP.
dockDownloadEmptyMessage: Select datasets from the dataset list or on the map to build a download.
filtersPanelHint: Pick any filter on the left to see its options here. Combine as many as you like to narrow what's shown on the map.
filtersPanelHintStep_select: Click a filter to open its options in this space.
filtersPanelHintStep_combine: Combine filters across categories. Results match all of them.
filtersPanelHintStep_exclude: Click an option once to include it, again to exclude it, a third time to clear it.
filtersPanelHintStep_live: Changes apply to the map right away, no confirmation needed.
filtersPanelHintStep_reset: Use “Clear all” below to remove every filter at once.
filtersModalSubtitleText: Narrow what's shown on the map
sidebarSelectionHintText: Add datasets with their download icon.
sidebarSelectionHintTitle: Click the download icon on a dataset to add it to this download.
selectionHelpModalSubtitleText: How a download is built, and what can't go into one.
selectionHelp_add_body: Click the download icon beside a dataset's title in the list. You can also add one straight from the map: click a point or a cell and use “Add this dataset to the selection” on the card that opens. Either way the count at the bottom of the list goes up.
selectionHelp_remove_title: Remove one, or change your mind later
selectionHelp_remove_body: A selected dataset shows a filled tick instead of the download icon. Click it again to take it out. The selection survives panning, filtering and searching, so you can gather datasets across several map clicks, and the Download window lets you untick anything before you submit.
selectionHelp_grid_body: Gridded (griddap) datasets are catalogued here but not served by the CDE, so their selection control is disabled. Open the dataset to reach its ERDDAP™ server and take the data there, where you can subset it yourself.
selectionHelp_size_body: In the Download window every selected dataset is measured against your filters. Anything still larger than 1 GB can't be delivered as a prepared archive: it is unticked and marked with a red cross, and the direct source link listed beside the order is how you get it. Narrowing the time, depth or map area usually brings it back under the limit.
selectionHelp_filters_title: Your filters travel with the order
selectionHelp_filters_body: Time, depth and the drawn area are applied to the download, and each can be switched off in the Download window. Three exceptions: direct ERDDAP™ links use the bounding box of a drawn polygon rather than its exact shape, datasets with no depth variable ignore the depth filter, and OBIS records come as the full dataset snapshot.
sidebarShowMapTitle: Show the map — the dataset stays open in a card
apiErrorBannerText: The data service is not responding, so filters and datasets could not be loaded.
harvest.downloads.title: Downloads
harvest.downloads.subtitle: Datasets requested through the data download tool, and how each request turned out.
harvest.downloads.queueStalled: {{count}} download request is queued with nothing processing it. The download scheduler may not be running.
harvest.downloads.queueStalled_plural: {{count}} download requests are queued with nothing processing them. The download scheduler may not be running.
harvest.downloads.noDatasets: No datasets have been downloaded yet.
harvest.downloads.noDatasetDetail: No per-dataset detail was recorded for this request.
harvest.downloads.reason.failed: Could not be retrieved from its source.
harvest.downloads.reason.ignored: Skipped because the download size limit was reached.
harvest.downloads.reason.partial: Only part of this dataset was included.
realtimeFilterTooltip: Show only datasets that were still producing data when they were last harvested.
realtimeFilterHelpText: Datasets whose newest data was less than a week old when we last checked.
datasetRealtimeBadgeTitle: This dataset was still producing data when it was last harvested. Coverage is across all of its records, as reported by the server.
directLinksTooltipText: Fetch each dataset straight from the server that publishes it, with no email, no queue and no 1 GB ceiling. The links carry whichever filters are switched on above. ERDDAP links use the bounding box of a drawn polygon; OBIS links use the polygon itself. Each export also carries the dataset's CIOOS catalogue record (licence, citation, contacts).
directLinksNotePolygon: ERDDAP links constrain by the latitude/longitude box around your selection. Where that selection is a drawn polygon rather than a rectangle, the files will include data from outside the shape.
directLinksNoteDepth_one: {{count}} dataset has no depth variable; its link leaves the depth filter out.
directLinksNoteDepth_other: {{count}} datasets have no depth variable; their links leave the depth filter out.
directLinksNoteUnfiltered_one: {{count}} OBIS snapshot is the whole dataset, unfiltered.
directLinksNoteUnfiltered_other: {{count}} OBIS snapshots are whole datasets, unfiltered.
legendHelp_observations_body: Hexagon colour and marker size count the same thing: days of data, meaning the distinct days on which anything was measured in that place.
legendHelp_hexes_body: Zoomed out, every dataset in view is summed into hexagonal cells, whatever kind of data it holds.
legendHelp_markers_body: Zoomed in past level 7, profile and time-series datasets stop being cells and are drawn at the locations they were collected from.
legendHelp_trajectories_line_body: The path a moving platform followed. Tracks ignore the time filter and draw the trailing window below instead.
legendHelp_trajectories_trail_body: How much history is drawn before the selected date. Zoomed out, the long windows load at most one year.
legendHelp_trajectories_head_body: Where the platform was on the selected date, and which way it was going. Set the date with the rail underneath.
legendHelp_seafloor_source_body: CHS NONNA soundings, drawn as part of the basemap. The ramp appears once the map is zoomed in far enough for those soundings to be drawn.
legendHelp_seafloor_reading_body: CHS publishes these tiles as colour rather than depth values, so the scale was calibrated from the imagery. Read it as bands, not contours; the bar is logarithmic.
legendHelp_layers_griddap_body: The bounding box of each gridded (griddap) dataset matching your filters. Gridded data is continuous over its whole box, so there is nothing to count per cell. It is drawn as an outline, not a colour ramp.
legendHelp_layers_download_body: The CDE does not prepare downloads for gridded data. Open a dataset to reach its ERDDAP™ server.
legendHelp_observations_once_body: However many datasets sampled it. Two moorings and a glider all recording on 1 January are one day of data between them, not three.
legendHelp_observations_gaps_body: The count follows the real sampling calendar: a station visited every January contributes those days alone, not the years in between.
legendHelp_observations_why_body: Record counts mix three different units across our sources (measurements, occurrence records and position fixes), and some are estimated from a sampling rate rather than measured. A day means the same thing everywhere, so any two places can be compared.
legendHelp_markers_size_body: Marker size shows the same count as a hexagon's colour. A marker is at its smallest at or below the number shown beside the small circle and grows from there. Where every location holds the same count there is no ramp to show, so they are all drawn at one size.
legendHelp_markers_colour_body: Mooring, ship, glider, and so on. Only the platform types present in your current results are listed, so the key never promises a colour the map is not drawing.
legendHelp_markers_cells_body: Trajectory tracks and OBIS occurrences are swept into coverage hexagons at every zoom, so those hexagons stay on the map underneath the markers.
legendHelp_hexes_hover_body: A cell's colour is a total. Point at one and its tooltip names what that total is made of.
legendHelp_hexes_scale_title: Scaled to what is on screen
legendHelp_hexes_scale_body: The scale is recalculated for the hexagons in view, so the same green means different amounts at different zooms.
